Under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, `_as_model_snapshots` returns its input unchanged. If `create_model` builds a model over only a subset of the network’s snapshots, `solve_model` still passes all of `n.snapshots` through the new callback helper, rather than the model’s stored snapshots, so the callback receives the wrong snapshot set.
